title: Spanish and Cuban people and guitar music
summary: She says there were many Cubans and Spanish families and plenty of guitar.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: You can understand Spanish then too? A little. Were there many Spanish people in the city when you were young that you remember?
Plenty, they had plenty, Cubans most so. And they had several Spanish families that I knew of. Then after that, those that came would not read Spanish, they were Cubans.
Did you hear much of Spanish music when you were a girl?
On guitar or anything? Guitar, yes.
Any Spanish pieces that you remember? Yes, guitar. Plenty, guitar.
